ordered_behavior: initDatalist builds a fresh cache and default trigger; settings folder/paths and checkbox load precede fuel-support check, built-in custom lists, user .cl files, supported monitor list, trigger list, monitor metadata, buffer construction and default/current selection.

Built-in lists sort by dispOrder and remove IDs7000..7499/8000..10099; first defaultDispFlag1 becomes DEFAULT_LIST. User .cl loads are serial; JSON filename must case-insensitively match customListName+.CL. Folder/file/parse failures in these optional list paths resolve rather than abort.

Signal support is the returned getDatMonSignalList signalDataList, not a UI assumption. ECU546 retains337, removes335/336 from displayed list, and marks synthesized337. Every custom list intersects the admitted signal IDs; empty lists disappear. Metadata is converted using each signal converter and current unitSetting.

getNewDatalist uses temporary cache only when isTemporary; selection ordering is OEM all-signal order for built-in/other IDs and preserves user order otherwise; missing metadata suppresses a displayed parameter. Optional DTC-count trigger adds a raw numeric counter, updates dtcCountPidId and creates graph metadata. Non-temporary replacement resets parameter trigger and updates sharedData.customListMap.

startDatalist shifts CHECK mode to NORMAL then confirms; snapshot1=MONITOR, snapshot2=WAITING. Buffer clearing precedes startDatMon; still non-normal check mode suppresses start. signal337 is replaced with335+336 in the native request. enable must be exactly1 before resetting frame/trigger/flag state and scheduling poll.

getDatMonValue rejects any nonempty messageList. Empty signalList records zero sampling frames and returns samplingRate only. Otherwise first timestamp becomes shared time origin; every sample time is mutated relative to it, lists sort newest-first, full data goes to buffer before conversion/trigger evaluation.

Live337 uses truthiness of both incoming335/336 data, Number conversion, divisor-zero=>0 and upper clamp100; absent/falsy operands yield {value:null,valueStr:""}. Selected DTC counter bypasses unit conversion. Waiting trigger transitions to RECORDING; recording expiry stops timer then awaits stopDatMon before STOP/isSaveData. Flag capture applies only during recording.

stopDatalist removes periodic scheduling before stopDatMon; success clears lastDtcCount and enters STOP. exitDatalist suppresses stop/check-mode errors, attempts normal-mode restoration+confirmation, and closes buffer only when cache exists and is no longer CHECK. No cancellation of an already-running PF request is implied by timer stop.

The dual implementation is not treated as equivalent to the single implementation. startDatMon sends one ordered startDataMonitorList containing base ecuId+signals then dualEcuId+signals, each independently substituting337 with335/336. It resets stoppingDatalist=false and requires enable===1.

A polling iteration awaits base getDatMonValue and buffer/conversion, then dual getDatMonValue and buffer/conversion; it returns both converted value lists. stoppingDatalist causes either subsequent acquisition to resolve false. Empty lists give that ECU no values; nonempty messageList rejects.

Both ECUs use the first nonempty sample timestamp as origin; getDatMonValue normalizes all samples in place. Frame count and sampling frameNum come from dual result, while triggering/recording state and lastDtcCount use base values. isFirstData is ORed across acquisitions. recordTime prefers base data and falls back to dual data.

Expiry sets stoppingDatalist=true, stops timer and awaits stopDatMon for the base ecuId. Returned STOP/isSaveData occurs after native stop success. Separate exact stop/exit/error paths remain in function contracts.

checkDtcSupport requires at least one ECU function1/16/30; monitor button additionally requires distributor displayMonitorStatus and MONITOR support. getDtc rejects absent/empty ecuFuncList; sends ecuId,busId,phaseType and function/detail request lists, never a presumed universal DTC service.

Permanent display setting defaults0; function32 is admitted only for setting===1 and CHECK_REGULATORY support. Detail set is1,2,3,4,6,42,57 plus43 when permanent display is truthy; ffdOption is included only when not undefined.

First scan order: getDtc(option0), optional custom-list folders/files+signal list, MIL, monitor status, enhanced/generic tab setting, saveSystemDtc and createReturnValue(true). Repeat uses cached custom lists and createReturnValue(false). First scan resolves revoke reasons; other failure maps to {result:resultInfo.code,errorCode:resultInfo.detailCode}. Repeat maps failures without revoke special handling.

getFfd branches on property existence of ffdInfo, not its truthiness. It serially reads each ffdId, fills missing multiData ffdType with bit0x10=>2 otherwise current type; first indexed successful response initializes merge, later responses merge by signal id and tuple(data,index,ffdType); per-read rejects resolve. No claim that a failed first indexed read produces a valid later merge.

Without ffdInfo, request includes optional ffdId when property exists; otherwise optional ssrNoList/sdrNoList. getFfd rejection resolves undefined. getFfdOfOneTime snapshots cache through JSON roundtrip before FFD, DTC item filters, optional detail-id list and detail reads, then returns selected enhanced/generic row plus parameter group lists.

Clear is mutating. Both DTC and Monitor clear first optionally writeAfterSalesZone when function1/detail67 is supported: date day/month+1/year from local Date plus raw commonInfo mileage. After-sales rejection is deliberately swallowed, then clear proceeds.

MAZDA_OEM uses clearDtcForMazda without per-ECU clear-support gate. Other OEM/generation paths require some function1/16/30 with detail7 or21 and send clearDtc({ecuId}); unsupported is a successful no-op at frontend.

DTC clear maps clear rejection to {result:code,errorCode:detailCode}; Monitor clear propagates rejection. UI confirmation/retry/rescan and disable/reenable transitions are separate controller graphs and are not implied by worker completion.

Initialization order is setting-file help/distributor country excerpt, optional MIL, PID01 normal monitor status, PID41 support probe, PID41 normal only if probe succeeds, serial PID01 results, serial PID41 results, then formatted result. MIL failure resolves; PID41 support failure sets false; PID01 per-linked result failure resolves; PID41 per-result failure propagates.

Linked test requests carry {ecuId,linkIdList,funcId:0}. Misfire system names additionally invoke getMisfireInfo. Return includes separate pid01View.tableData,pid41View.tableData,ecuInfo and settings. Repeat builds fresh modelCache and commits it only when !loopCancelFlag; exact order includes writing ecuCache from previous model.cache.data before replacement.

Test pass compares raw data against optional raw minLimitData/maxLimitData: below min or above max fails; equality passes, undefined limits do not fail. Unit conversion is performed independently for data/min/max for displayed strings. All detail-pass=>summary PASS, no details=>EMPTY, otherwise FAIL.

PID01 and current/PID41 condition/status remapping differ; full switch matrices and summary A..F icon guards are retained in convertViewData statement graph. Misfire rows override detail.result=MISFIRE, clear min/max, set testSummary=EMPTY after summaryIcon computation.

getMisfireInfo starts general communication with ecuId/busId, checks generic22 F8 10, then sequential22 F5 02/03/04/05 reads. ErrorCode presence skips that read; response strips first3 bytes. Payload byte0 advertises8 signals; each admitted signal is a BE16 at offsets1,3,..15 and scaled1 offset0 with nominal0..65535. try/catch returns accumulated results; finally always awaits endGeneralComm (rejection swallowed).

Each variant independently loads PC/distributor country permanent-display setting, sorts mounted ECUs by dbIndex, obtains softwareId and produces initial ECU rows. Initialization failure becomes {result:false,...already-cached rows}, not rejected promise.

start begins 100ms message-queue polling, optionally initializes wired vehicle collection and turns log collection ON when carryOut and VIN/engine target. ECUs process serially; isCancel skips later ECUs but does not abort current PF request. Connected status plus function1/16/30[/32 when setting truthy] selects current detail1 across eligible functions, falling back to past detail2 only if no current requests. option0 requests no FFD.

DTC error resolves undefined and yields UNKNOWN; [] yields NORMAL, nonempty yields ABNORMAL, disconnected yields WITHOUT. QDC-CID separately admits CID function and obtains cidList; no ordinary-QDC equivalence is assumed for that branch.

Collection chooses WVDC_VIN_{NA,JP,EU,OT}.vds and WVDC_VehicleType_{NA,JP,EU,OT}.vds with exact region match; uses VIN or vehicleType||IT3_division||IT3_modelCode and engineType||IT3_engineType. Collection/API failures are swallowed. Ending turns logging OFF and flashWiredVehicleData constructs VIC_<softwareId>_<UTC timestamp>.json plus GTS-C02 metadata; this is data collection/output, not ECU reflashing.
Final END message includes local timestamp selected by dateFormat and cancellation flag; then isCancel resets. cancelDtcCheck only sets flag. endDtcCheck resets flag and stops message polling.

clear serially rechecks connections/functions, writes after-sales zone when1/67 supported; ordinary clear requires1/16/30 with7/21. MAZDA phase21 global clear executes at most once (yetCleared gate). First non-normal resultInfo is retained across resolves/rejects while processing continues; final result:true is accompanied by accumulated resultInfo.

Calculation selection is PHASE_3 first, else any supportInfoByCylList function/detail gate chooses AfterPhase4Another, else only PHASE_4/PHASE_5 chooses AfterPhase4. There is no inferred Phase6/default return. All PID maps and support table entries are retained as program bindings.

First cycle initializes preData and dtime0; later dtime is raw latestDataTime delta. distance accumulates speed*dtime/1000/3600. P3 fuel accumulation uses data.dspd (as shipped), while instantaneous ratio denominator uses data.despd; later variants use engine speed data.despd for fuel accumulation. All formulas and finite-number/zero guards remain exact in function graphs.

P3 cylinder count parses commonInfo; ordinary later variant ECU372 maps PID9806/9802/9803 to3/4/6, ECU456 PID9802=>4, otherwise uses data value. Another variant assigns cylinder3 then4 by support conditions, allowing later assignment to override. NHW correction is0.95 only phase4/5.

Average economy distance0=>0.1 and consumed-fuel0=>100. Instantaneous speed0=>0.1 and zero engine-speed/dtime/injection/cylinder=>100. Stopped time, gear percentages and A/C use source-specific accumulators; graphs preserve differences including P3 reinitialization behavior.

Unit rounding paths exist only phase3 versus phase4/5. Display rows additionally include selected/trigger PID conversions. ECU546 signal337 falsy data yields empty strings. resetFuelconsumption resets preData,time/frame/trigger/flags/isRecordingTimeOver locally; it is not sent as an ECU reset.
Recording, polling start/stop, buffer save/cancel and state transitions are separate source contracts; recording has buffer/file/native-stop effects and is not classified read-only.

createConverter shallow-copies metadata; missing converter object returns null. Pattern types1/20/22 use Number(value) lookup in dispInfoList; unknown values have undefined valueStr. Numeric types2/21/23/25/26/28/29/30 use genre-selected user unit tables. Hex3/31 uses uppercase Number(value).toString(16) padded ceil(bitLength/4). ASCII4/32 and DIAG_CODE5 keep input text and return NaN numeric value.

Min/max13/24/27/33 first sets pattern endpoints from source dataMin/dataMax according to first-two-pattern ordering, then unit-converts endpoints; converter replaces value/valueStr at >=max and <=min using endpoint metadata. Empty/malformed endpoints are not invented; catch only covers setup.

TIME_HH_MM19 formats Number(value) minutes as zero-padded hours:minutes. LUX6,S_10BIT7,S_12BIT8,U_10BIT9,S_8BIT10,U_16BIT11,REV_LSB12,REV_LSB_NCB34 and default use convertNone; native extraction/decoding is upstream, not reverse-decoded again by frontend.

Numeric converters replace one comma with period for parsing, round Math.round(n*10^decPnt)/10^decPnt, toFixed(decPnt), then restore decimal comma when input contained it. Unit setting LSBnull uses100/Number(value); others Number(value)*LSB+OFFSET. convertNone preserves nonnumeric text as valueStr. No frontend guards are fabricated for invalid precision/unit table indices.

All13 unit tables, genre mappings, conversion factors, pressure absolute/gauge offsets and locale/date/time helpers are retained in source-root function graphs; distinct constants are not collapsed to exemplar units.

Stored read wrappers retrieve StoredDataManager.getStoredData(storedId,true), relocalize when stored language differs, and build converters from persisted signal metadata/current unitSetting. MenuShell owns StoredDataManager/BufferInterface/GtsBaseBuffer/container runtime; DataCaptureReports owns stored_data UI/worker/CSV projections. Graph/read projections remain here.

Single datalist selects persisted customList[0].pidIdList; dtc counter synthesizes numeric metadata. Stored ECU546+337 derives335/336 aligned by array index, divisor-zero=>0 and clamp100; this differs from live falsy-operand empty behavior. Stored samplingRate computes Math.round(lastTime/frameNum) when both truthy.

Graph stored saveFlagList forwards {storedId,flagList}; graph edit memo/settings/axis/line/bar/LED/meter transforms, event bindings, static/dynamic sorting/zoom/range behavior and disposal are retained method-by-method with the complete graph program/function effects. No graph module import is substituted for those effects.

openCanBusScreen separates MAZDA, CENTRAL_GW and old branches. Central-GW fetch uses selected canBusDisplayId only when confirmBusConfig, passes category/ECU/histPidSupport entries plus canBusOptionId; it reads current time serially for each connected communication ECU, including ecuId0 as connected. Missing time entries become null in saved list.

Old branch reads categoryIdLstList then current/history connection rows. Initial current connections are WHITE; history-only RED. Subsequent disappearance becomes RED; RED reappearance or newly current entry becomes YELLOW; previously present colors are preserved; new history-only remains RED. Central-GW uses systemId+categoryId matching for prior row lookup, with distinct update code.

MAZDA loops only MAZDA_OEM mounted ECUs and excludes ecuId862, asks checkCanBusEcuConnectForMazda. Initial connected WHITE/disconnected RED; RED reconnection YELLOW; disconnect RED. Ordered requests and returned field defaults remain exact in worker graphs.
Clear, malfunction-check, periodic startup/stop, save/stored-data paths remain separate method/effect contracts; CAN-bus status display is not assumed read-only when a clear action is selected.

_startHealthCheck computes execute pattern and CAN support, awaits CGW and wired collection setup, then serial mounted-ECU loop. Each loop skips undefined/cancelled/missing ECU, constructs independent cache sections, emits start UI message, checks ECU status with optional cache invalidation, clones function/status state and only connected ECUs run DTC/monitor/RoB/CID acquisition.

For each processed ECU it awaits DTC/MIL error check, special-operation-history, ABS history, operation history, predictiveFFD, individual stores and save before view conversion and end-ECU message. Business algorithms of those history/utility owners are joined, not transferred to native closure here.

After ECU scan, cancellation runs summary-end and returns early. Otherwise activity report, timestamp, CAN-bus and tire-pressure acquisition and messages run in order; if still not cancelled, SOH and calibration/health/priority/result/production-date/SAAP web calls follow. SU-result, PSIRT, wired-collection end, RoB web save and summary finish follow in source order.

Outer catch is not a general finally cleanup: it returns revoke UI message when e.revoke, otherwise undefined. No cleanup beyond explicit source paths is claimed. cancelHealthCheck only acts if isRunning && !cancelFlag, first awaits wired-data end, stores optional cancelAfterFunc/Args, sets cancelFlag and queues cancellation-start message.

saveHealthCheckData creates HealthCheck buffer, shallow-copies cache.data, filters truthy ECU entries, saves, outputs activity link, saves Ipk and cache. finally sets isRunning=false. Customer-friendly report derives API input milInput from captured ECU CID/MIL/DTC sections and may return url/revoke/empty url; external endpoint behavior belongs outside offline source.

Every OEM/generation-specific status/CID/clear/RoB/cache branch is retained in the full function contracts, including explicit phase6 configuration display helpers and Suzuki CID combination; native decoders/writers remain cross-layer joins.

Raw wrappers call this.send(exact PFCMD constant,param,receiveAck) and return the same promise. All233 current simple wrappers and236 command constants are preserved in pf_catalog/raw_command_constants; non-simple raw runtime methods remain shared MenuShell-owned.

Read facade methods preserve receiveAck semantics: when response.response exists, conversion/translation is attached to that final-response promise and the acknowledgement wrapper resolves immediately; otherwise conversion/translation is applied directly to response. Acknowledgement is not equated to final ECU result.

getDtc partition uses kindFlag0 enhanced and1 generic. Enhanced Phase5/6 bypasses mergeCore; other enhanced and all generic separate comment==="1" from other rows. mergeCore deduplicates by dtcCode, ORs ffdType, unions kind values, merges timeStampList by(keyCycle,elapsedTime,ffdType), merges FFD by id and multiData by(data,index,ffdType), and deduplicates(ffdId,ffdType). mergeDtc2Row starts from non-comment1 codes and only appends matching comment1 rows, so unmatched comment1-only rows are not emitted by that merge.

DTC ffdType16 maps nested multiData ffdType to2 before merge; other types propagate. Translation batches name/unit/timestamp-unit/FFD/display-pattern names using exact resource IDs and existing default strings, then writes translated fields through setTranslateStr. All remaining read API payload/result transforms and their exception/return branches are in exact function contracts, not treated as identity wrappers.

The raw websocket request map, send/cancel/connection owner and common runtime exception classification remain typed MenuShell seams. Native PID/DTC/FFD/identity decoding roles must be composed by native owners from the exact API ID and actual ecuId/busId/phaseType fields.

data.crossing_interpretation: Only actual owned-member gtsPFApi receiver calls appear in pf_call_refs. Global per-call table is shared once across frontend owners; source common contracts define business ordering, not PF facade declarations.
